description: After a zas_send_direct job failed in flight, deliver the same file through reliable delivery instead. Zas encrypts the file on this machine and stores only that encrypted copy in Cloudflare R2 for up to 24 hours; it uses none of the owner's space, and the device that claimed the offer can download it later. This stops being Directo: the encrypted bytes pass through storage. Ask the owner before you use it; it is their choice. Pass the failed job's id. The owner sees every item this agent sends with the >_ agent mark and this agent's name, on every device.

job.description: The job id zas_send_direct or zas_jobs reported for the Directo send that failed.

name: zas_send_direct_fallback
